pages.text: Flax isn't only for bowstrings. Weave $(l)Flax String$() into $(l)Linen$(): a soft, wool-like block for building and furnishing your workshop.
Four Flax String makes one Linen.

pages.title: Colours & Shapes
pages.text: $(l)8 Linen + any dye$() gives 8 of that colour, and because the recipe takes $(o)any$() linen, you can re-dye a colour you've changed your mind about.$(br2)All 17 colours come with $(l)stairs$(), a $(l)slab$() and a $(l)carpet$().

pages.title: Like Wool
pages.text: Linen counts as wool: shears cut it quickly, and it makes $(l)beds$() and $(l)banners$() just like wool does.$(br2)The $(l)Shepherd$() trades in it too: buying plain linen, and selling dyed linen and carpets.
